title: New Generation
author: Sushant Thapa
text:
A makeup artist
Knows what is beauty,
Only when he understands
The difference between
Beauty tools and a real face.
What to use for beauty,
Tools or a real face?
Or some essence of universality,
Or a peeping soul.
Soul is always
An easy license
Of measureless
Search for depth.
Art of beauty needs a display;
Appreciation is only the aftermath.
Experimentation
Is a true sign of affection.
Learners defeat
The learned ones
And creation sprouts
Like a fountain of new generation.

©️Sushant Thapa
Biratnagar, Nepal
